profiles.uid: Unique TEST native slot UID except PostgreSQL engine children inherently share its private DB-service UID; no participant receives another slot key or writable memory
profiles.filesystem: Immutable private code/libs/config mount; no writable executable/plugin paths. Only native registry writer auxiliary owns its fixed journal append FD; participant inputs read from sealed descriptors, outputs through exact authenticated fd5
profiles.capabilities: Drop all Linux capabilities before enrollment; enforcer may retain only CAP_KILL in disposable TEST user/PID namespace, under exact fd6 signal filter. No SYS_ADMIN/SYS_PTRACE/SETUID/SETGID/NET_ADMIN operational capability
profiles.bootstrap: Only HOST_PLATFORM can create namespace/UID/mount/capability policy and approve release; SUPERVISOR fixed bootstrap spawn is PRE_ENROLLMENT only, loses spawn/exec/UID authority before active. Replacement requires old generation drain and a new bootstrap phase, never active generic spawner
profiles.argument_rules: Non-engine role IO only declared descriptors; fcntl only F_GETFD/F_GETFL/F_GET_SEALS, no dup/replacement. Anonymous mmap RW only, no writable executable mappings; allocator syscalls bounded by sealed memory quota. recvmsg fd5 only with strict ancillary checks; close only owned temporary validation handles, never protected target fd6
profiles.signal_rules: Only enforcer fd6 may receive SIGSTOP,SIGTERM,SIGCONT in fixed order once; deny kill/tkill/tgkill, pidfd_open/getfd, arbitrary FD creation/replacement, exec, ptrace/process_vm_writev. Any rejected syscall quarantines and outcome UNKNOWN
profiles.POSTMASTER_boundary: PostgreSQL engine remains the explicit frozen service/trusted implementation, not a generic native worker/broker: private TEST PGDATA and socket namespace only, approved engine/modules immutable, no host/prod mount/network/credential; only exact preprovisioned non-superuser native observer roles may reach read-only TEST snapshot function. No native message carries SQL. Full database mutation mechanism closure remains V2-PARTITIONS outside this gate
profiles.unresolved: Engine OS-service policy and complete libc/OpenSSL syscall allowlist + argument-filter source-to-effect verification still require independent review; a proposed list alone is not proof
